rationale: Current best already relies on a float-kept projection tail plus the rank-64 bigram head, but the late EMA finalizer still only averages quantized projection weights. This patch extends that same cheap endgame averaging to the actual output-tail tensors now driving the final exact int8 score: all projection weights plus logit gain/bias and the bigram tail weights/scale. It preserves shapes, step structure, quantization, and wallclock behavior while targeting lower final_int8_zlib_roundtrip_exact val_bpb.
title: Float-Kept Tail EMA On Bigram64
